info.title: CopyPaste marketing connector synchronization
info.description: Additive account discovery, company authorization launcher, durable pagination, retry/cancel, immutable source facts/export and scoped Admin metadata/revocation. Callback and original strict Connection/Sync/Snapshot/AdminOperation remain governed by the unchanged normative contract. Protocol-shaped local HTTP fixtures are synthetic; no live provider, full role or whole-product acceptance is asserted.

200.description: Without format: bounded facts page. format=json: retained full frozen snapshot JSON. format=csv: UTF-8 BOM CSV attachment with JSON dimensions/metrics; requires the same current source/project gates.

ConnectorQuery.description: Server-frozen provider/account/report grain/dates/API version; never accepted from a user as a replacement query. Google and Meta campaign normalization has separate CSV source lineage.

data_as_of.description: Platform extraction cutoff; null when the source file does not prove it. Upload time must not substitute for this value.
